rows.49:2070:
Back then, making that kind of confession was the man's job.
These days so many men are spineless that the women seem to be the strong ones.
Around the time the cherry blossoms bloomed, Hirooka finally made up his mind.
He would perform the legendary ritual beneath the cherry tree in full bloom.
"...Orihara. If you don't mind, would you come with me, just the two of us, under those cherry blossoms?"
You understand what it meant when he said the two of them would go there, don't you?
Orihara blushed and gave a small nod.
How happy Hirooka was at that moment...
I can picture it as plainly as if it were right in front of me.
And so he asked her.
"When would be good for you?"{p}What do you think Orihara answered?
rows.49:2840:
Can you believe it? Someone had come to the cherry tree before them.
And at the very moment they were kissing, no less.
If the legend was true, misfortune would now fall upon that couple.
"Ah!"
And before they could stop themselves, Hirooka and Orihara cried out.{p}
